title: Merry Happy Whatever
search_title_used: Merry Happy Whatever December 21 Welcome Matt
premise_summary: Merry Happy Whatever is an American sitcom television series starring Dennis Quaid. The series premiered on Netflix on November 28, 2019, and consisted of eight episodes. In April 2020, the series was canceled after one season.
